title: Processing the three open supplier invoices

steps.title: Open invoice INV-4471
steps.decision: Start with the oldest open invoice, from Weber Maschinenbau

reason.text: I always take the oldest one first, otherwise the supplier starts calling us about payment terms.
reason.speaker: Sabine

steps.title: Check supplier and amount
steps.decision: Amount is 7,200 euros for a machine, so this is not a normal running cost

reason.text: Seven thousand two hundred for a machine, that's not a running cost, that's equipment. Alarm bells.
reason.speaker: Sabine

steps.title: Code the invoice to a cost center

reason.text: It comes prefilled with 4711, but anything that's a machine over five thousand is an asset. I change it to 0400.
reason.speaker: Sabine

steps.title: Enter the asset number
steps.decision: Looked up the asset number in the register before saving

reason.text: Capex without an asset number gets bounced by accounting every time, so I never save without it.
reason.speaker: Sabine

steps.title: Open INV-4472 and spot the duplicate
steps.decision: Put Nordtec GmbH invoice on hold instead of approving

reason.text: Nordtec, December, same amount as the November line. That smells like a duplicate, so I hold it and ask them.
reason.speaker: Sabine

steps.title: Open INV-4473 and route for second approval
steps.decision: Routed Vltava s.r.o. invoice to a second approver instead of approving myself

reason.text: Vltava is the Czech subsidiary, I'm not allowed to approve those alone. It always goes to a second person.
reason.speaker: Sabine

steps.title: Save and confirm the posting
steps.decision: Saved the invoices that were cleared and left the held one open

reason.text: Only after all the checks do I hit Save. Once it's booked it's a pain to reverse.
reason.speaker: Sabine

guardrails.statement: Equipment over 5,000 euros must not be coded to opex 4711

reason.text: Over five thousand it's an asset, full stop. Nobody books that to 4711.
reason.speaker: Sabine

guardrails.statement: No asset number, no capex booking

reason.text: No asset number, no capex. If it's missing I stop and ask the asset accountant.
reason.speaker: Sabine

guardrails.statement: Nordtec December invoices duplicate the November run and must be held

reason.text: With Nordtec the December invoice is nearly always the November one sent again. Hold it, never pay.
reason.speaker: Sabine

guardrails.statement: Czech subsidiary invoices need a second approval

reason.text: Anything from the Czech entity needs a second signature, that's the rule from the auditors.
reason.speaker: Sabine

open_questions: Is the 5,000 euro capex threshold the same for every supplier, or only for equipment?
What happens when the Nordtec December invoice turns out not to be a duplicate?
